spacing_and_layout.portfolio_grid: Bento 'Tetris' grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8 to create asymmetry.

components.header: Sticky with backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#F7F7F5]/80, subtle bottom border. Include Logo, Nav Links, and 'Get a Quote' button.
components.hero: Large visual impact. Render a max-h-[85vh] rounded-[2rem] overflow-hidden container with the hero image. Use a gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-r from-[#2B2B2B]/90 via-[#2B2B2B]/50 to-transparent`) to ensure text readability on the left while keeping the architectural steel visible on the right.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C58B2A] text-white hover:bg-[#b07a22] transition-colors shadow-md hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-[#2B2B2B] text-white hover:bg-[#1a1a1a] transition-colors shadow-md hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium
buttons.floating_whatsapp: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-2xl hover:scale-110 transition-transform

components.cards: bg-white shadow-sm border border-[#B0B7C3]/20 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input/Textarea. Customize inputs to have bg-[#F7F7F5] and focus:ring-[#2B2B2B].

hero.description: Wide-angle photograph of a modern luxury home exterior in Nairobi featuring premium black steel balconies and windows.

workshop_about.description: Professional steel fabricator in a modern workshop examining custom railing.

portfolio.description: Premium gate detail with gold accents
Black metal frame under white sky

interactions_and_motion.scroll: Implement smooth scrolling natively or via Lenis if applicable.
interactions_and_motion.hover_effects: Portfolio images should scale slightly (scale-105) on hover inside an overflow-hidden container.
interactions_and_motion.reveal: Use Framer Motion to stagger-fade-in sections and grid items as they enter the viewport.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure the text on #F7F7F5 background maintains an APCA contrast ratio. Keep gold (#C58B2A) for large elements or icons only, do not use it for small body text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON thoroughly. ALL media URLs here MUST be used. DO NOT USE placeholder image services.
Setup Tailwind config to include the specified colors (primary, secondary, accent, background).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts (Hero, Features, Portfolio) to allow for bento-grid asymmetry.
Use Shadcn UI components for the Contact Form, Select (if needed), and Dialogs/Sheets for mobile menu.
Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts are properly loaded and applied via Tailwind utility classes.
